components.name: Shape
components.description:
Zen Shape: Figma's native shapes (Rectangle, Ellipse with its arc, Line, Arrow, Polygon, Star, and the Pen's Vector)
for illustrations, marks and decoration drawn in Zen Studio. Not a Figma library component: it maps to Figma's own
nodes (RECTANGLE, ELLIPSE with arcData, LINE, REGULAR_POLYGON, STAR, VECTOR) on export and import. Colours are Zen tokens only (`fill` from
Color/Background, `stroke` from Color/Border); the rectangle's radius takes the Corner-Radius tokens. It sizes and
places like a layout primitive: `width` / `height` (px or fill) and Figma's position props (in a free frame:
`position="absolute"` with px insets).
components.extends: Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "children">, LayoutSizingProps, LayoutPositionProps, CornerRadiusProps, ImageFillProps, GradientFillProps

props.name: width
props.description:
Horizontal resizing, as in Figma auto layout. Unset keeps the element's usual width.
`"hug"` (Hug contents): as wide as its content, never grows or stretches.
`"fill"` (Fill container): in a row Stack it takes an equal share of the space left after each child's padding
and may shrink to 0; in a column Stack it stretches across; in a Grid cell or a plain block it takes the full
width. Fill children in a wrapping row need a `minWidth` to wrap.
A number: Fixed width in px, which never shrinks in a flex row. Sizes include padding and border (border-box).
(Container's `maxWidth` is a different prop: a token width, sm…full.)
Prefer hug or fill; use Fixed only for widths that really are fixed (a side column, a preview frame).

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Minimum width in px (Figma min width). Wins over fill's shrink-to-0.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum width in px (Figma max width), e.g. a readable line length for a Fill block of text.

props.name: alignSelf
props.description:
This element's alignment inside its parent: start · center · end · stretch across a Stack's
direction (vertical in a row, horizontal in a column), vertical inside a Grid cell. Overrides the parent's `align`
for this child. A `"fill"` size on the same axis still fills; in a column, alignSelf then places it once maxWidth
stops it. No effect outside a Stack or Grid.

props.name: height
props.description:
Vertical resizing, as in Figma auto layout. Unset keeps the element's usual height.
`"hug"` (Hug contents): as tall as its content, never grows or stretches.
`"fill"` (Fill container): in a column Stack it takes an equal share of the free height; it shrinks below its
content only when the column has a height of its own (Fixed, Fill or maxHeight), else it keeps its content height
(pass `minHeight={0}` for a scrolling child of a column sized from outside). In a row Stack it stretches to the
row's height; in a Grid cell it fills the cell (over alignSelf); in a plain block it takes 100% (the parent needs
a height).
A number: Fixed height in px, which does not shrink in a column Stack.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Minimum height in px (Figma min height). Wins over fill's shrink-to-0.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height in px (Figma max height).

props.name: position
props.description:
Figma "Ignore auto layout" (layoutPositioning ABSOLUTE). `"absolute"` takes the element out of its parent's flow
and pins it to the parent Stack, Grid, Box or Card with `constraintX` / `constraintY`; siblings, `gap`, `justify`
and the parent's Hug size ignore it, as in Figma. Siblings written after it paint above it (Figma auto layout
"Last on top"), so put background media first. Default `"static"` (in flow). Only Stack, Grid and Box take it:
wrap a Text or a component in a Box. Badges, status dots and a Card sub-action are component props, never insets.

props.name: constraintX
props.description:
Figma horizontal constraint, read only with `position="absolute"`: `left` (default, Figma Left) · `right` (Right)
· `left-right` (Left & right: stretches between the two offsets, `width` is ignored) · `center` (Center: exact
centre, the X offsets are ignored). Figma Scale is not offered (it needs percentages, which are not tokens).

props.name: constraintY
props.description:
Figma vertical constraint, read only with `position="absolute"`: `top` (default) · `bottom` · `top-bottom`
(Top & bottom: stretches between the two offsets, `height` is ignored) · `center` (exact centre).

props.name: insetTop
props.description:
Offset from the parent's top edge on Spacing/Padding (none 0 · 3xs 2 · 2xs 4 · xs 8 · sm 12 · md 16 · lg 20 ·
xl 24 · 2xl 32 · 3xl 40 · 4xl 48; Figma Y snapped to the padding ladder). Read only when `constraintY` pins the
top edge (`top`, `top-bottom`). Default none (flush). Measured from the parent's padding box, as Figma ignores the
frame's padding for absolute children. A number is px: Figma's Y in a free frame (a Box or Screen without auto
layout, where Zen Studio draws shapes and frames); it may be negative (the layer starts above the frame and clips).

props.name: insetRight
props.description: Offset from the parent's right edge on Spacing/Padding, or px in a free frame. Read only when `constraintX` is `right` or `left-right`. Default none.

props.name: insetBottom
props.description: Offset from the parent's bottom edge on Spacing/Padding, or px in a free frame. Read only when `constraintY` is `bottom` or `top-bottom`. Default none.

props.name: insetLeft
props.description: Offset from the parent's left edge on Spacing/Padding (Figma X snapped to the ladder), or Figma's X in px in a free frame. Read only when `constraintX` is `left` or `left-right`. Default none.

props.name: radiusTopLeft
props.description:
Top-left corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma topLeftRadius; none · 2xs 2 · xs 4 · sm 8 · md 12 · lg 16 ·
xl 20 · 2xl 24 · 3xl 28 · full), following the radius mode. A set corner wins over `radius`, as `paddingX` wins
over `padding`; unset corners keep `radius`. Don't mix `full` with a finite corner (`radius="full"
radiusBottomRight="xs"`): `full` is Corner-Radius/Rounded (1000px), so the browser scales every corner down to fit
the box and the small one renders square. Use a finite radius (a chat tail: `radius="xl" radiusBottomRight="xs"`);
`full` mixes only with `none`.

props.name: radiusTopRight
props.description: Top-right corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma topRightRadius). Wins over `radius`.

props.name: radiusBottomRight
props.description: Bottom-right corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma bottomRightRadius). Wins over `radius`.

props.name: radiusBottomLeft
props.description: Bottom-left corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma bottomLeftRadius). Wins over `radius`.

props.name: image
props.description:
An image fill (Figma's Image paint): the picture's URL, painted over the layer's fill and under its stroke. A picture
that means something needs an accessible name on its layer; without one it is decoration. A picture in the content
(an article photo, a product shot) is an Image (alt, ratio, caption), not a fill.

props.name: imageFit
props.description:
How the picture fills the layer (Figma's image scale mode): `fill` (default) covers it and crops what overflows,
`fit` shows the whole picture, `crop` the part `imageCrop` names, stretched to the layer, `tile` repeats it at
`imageScale`.

props.name: imageCrop
props.type: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }
props.description: With `imageFit="crop"`: the part of the picture shown, in percent of it, e.g. { x: 10, y: 0, width: 80, height: 100 }. Unset: as `fill`.

props.name: imageScale
props.description: With `imageFit="tile"`: each tile's size in percent of the picture's own size (Figma's tile scale). Default 100.

props.name: gradient
props.description:
A gradient fill (Figma's Linear, Radial, Angular or Diamond paint) whose stops are colour variables (paint slugs, as
a Shape's `fill`): it paints over the layer's fill colour (a Shape then has none unless `fill` is given) and under an
image fill. Diamond is drawn as four linear quadrants (CSS has none).

props.name: type
props.description:
The shape, as Figma's shape tools draw it: `rectangle` (default; Figma RECTANGLE), `ellipse` (ELLIPSE, with an arc),
`line` (LINE: `width` is its length, `rotation` its angle, no height), `arrow` (a LINE with Figma's "Line arrow" end
cap), `polygon` (REGULAR_POLYGON, `pointCount` corners), `star` (STAR, `pointCount` tips, `starRatio`) and `vector`
(VECTOR: the path `d` in its `viewBox`, as the Pen draws it) and `boolean` (BOOLEAN_OPERATION: its shapes, the
children, combined by `operation`; Zen Studio writes the result as `d`).

props.name: operation
props.description: A boolean group's operation (`type="boolean"`): `union` (default), `subtract`, `intersect` or `exclude`, as Figma's.

props.name: children
props.description: A boolean group's shapes (`type="boolean"`): placed at their X / Y inside it, not drawn themselves; their combined outline is.

props.name: d
props.description:
A vector's path (`type="vector"`): SVG path data in absolute M / L / C / Q / Z commands only (what Figma's vectorPaths
take), in the coordinates of `viewBox`. Zen Studio's Pen and Pencil write it.

props.name: viewBox
props.description: The box a vector's `d` is written in ("minX minY width height"); the path stretches from it to the shape's size, as Figma scales a vector. Default: the path's own bounds.

props.name: fillRule
props.description: How a vector's overlapping sub-paths fill (Figma's winding rule): `nonzero` (default) or `evenodd` (holes).

props.name: fill
props.description:
Fill: a Color/Background token by its path ("neutral-subtle", "accent-solid", "surface", "support-blue-soft"; list in
`shapeFills`), or "none". Default: Background/Support/Neutral/Soft, Figma's light grey; a line, arrow or vector has none,
and a shape with an `image` or a `gradient` has none unless it is given (the colour then shows around a `fit` picture,
or through a gradient's transparent stops).

props.name: stroke
props.description: Stroke: a Color/Border token by its path ("neutral-solid", "accent-subtle", "support-teal-solid"; `shapeStrokes`), or "none" (default; a line, arrow or vector takes Border/Neutral/Solid).

props.name: strokeWeight
props.description: Stroke weight in px (Figma strokeWeight). Default 1.

props.name: strokeAlign
props.description: Where the stroke sits on the edge: `inside` (default, as Figma's shapes), `center` (a line's and a vector's) or `outside`.

props.name: radius
props.description: Rectangle corner radius on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma cornerRadius); `radiusTopLeft` … override single corners.

props.name: arcStart
props.description: Ellipse arc Start in degrees, clockwise from 3 o'clock (Figma's Arc › Start; arcData.startingAngle). Default 0.

props.name: arcSweep
props.description: Ellipse arc Sweep in percent of a full turn (Figma's Arc › Sweep): 100 (default) the whole ellipse, 25 a quarter pie.

props.name: arcRatio
props.description: Ellipse arc Ratio in percent (Figma's Arc › Ratio; arcData.innerRadius): the hole of a ring or donut. Default 0.

props.name: pointCount
props.description: Polygon corners or star tips (Figma Count, 3 … 60). Default 3 for a polygon, 5 for a star.

props.name: starRatio
props.description: Star inner radius in percent of the outer one (Figma Ratio). Default 38.2.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Rotation in degrees, counter-clockwise positive, as Figma's rotation field. Turns the shape about its centre.

props.name: flip
props.description: Figma's Flip horizontal (⇧H) or Flip vertical (⇧V): the shape mirrored on that axis about its centre.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Layer opacity in percent (Figma's layer opacity, 0 … 100). Default 100.

props.name: blendMode
props.description:
Figma's layer blend (Appearance › blend mode, the Plugin API's `blendMode`): how the shape mixes with what lies under
it, as CSS's `mix-blend-mode` of the same name. Default `normal`; `pass-through` is a frame's and draws as normal here.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for a shape that means something (a status mark, a chart legend dot); without it the shape is decorative and hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the shape's root element.

types.GradientStop: interface GradientStop { color: Exclude<ShapeFill, "none">; at: number; }
types.ZenGradient: interface ZenGradient { type: GradientType; angle?: number; stops: GradientStop[]; }
